gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-kumbh-sans: Bold, quirky and open. Bellota Text sets rounded, unshaded letters up top, while Kumbh Sans follows with short-cut terminals in a sans-serif body. Make the heading small and it loses its punch.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-lato: Bellota Text draws every stroke stout and uniform, like a bent pipe cleaner, and that gives headings real presence. Lato, a sans with wide, barely curled s curves, is the one that handles the quiet work underneath.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-libre-franklin: Round bowls whose walls never swell or thin give Bellota Text a stamped, confident look up top. And Libre Franklin, a plain sans with a splayed c terminal, carries the longer reading along smoothly.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-livvic: Livvic reads friendly and straightforward, with curves that carry no stress and a generous opening in the c. Yet Bellota Text above it keeps things distinctive, so a long page feels welcoming without turning dull.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-lunasima: Pen-drawn and punchy: Bellota Text looks like letters from a fixed-width nib, open and unshaded. But Lunasima, a sans with c tips that never creep toward touching, keeps a long read crisp and contemporary.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-lxgw-marker-gothi: Crossbars that match the stems in thickness make Bellota Text instantly recognizable as a heading. LXGW Marker Gothic, a sans with a wide-open c and strokes only slightly heavier than its thin ones, supplies the pair's quiet contrast.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-m-plus-1: Bellota Text has open, unshaded letterforms with no calligraphic pressure to guide the eye, giving headings a bold, distinct presence. M PLUS 1, a plain sans, offers wide-eyed e and a shapes in a fineliner line.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-m-plus-1p: Commanding is how Bellota Text lands, with lines that are never heavier on the downstrokes. M PLUS 1p, a sans, stays open at every curve end, so the two sit comfortably together on the page.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-m-plus-2: M PLUS 2 is approachable, with a gaping c opening and one fixed nib width throughout. But Bellota Text overhead brings the distinctive punch, and that mix of friendliness and command is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-m-plus-rounded-1c: Chunky, even-handed and confident. Bellota Text holds its stroke width constant, and M PLUS Rounded 1c, a plain sans with terminals that stop short of curling back in, gives a long page a soft, approachable pace.
